;Business and economy
*[[History of AT&T]] 
**A U.S. federal judge approves [[AT&T]]'s [[USD|$]]85 billion merger with [[Time Warner]]. [https://www.npr.org/2018/06/12/614092532/u-s-judge-approves-at-ts-85-billion-merger-with-time-warner (NPR)]
*[[Tesla, Inc.|Tesla]] announces that it intends to cut 3000 jobs in an attempt to improve profitability. Many of those workers will be offered alternative jobs under the same employer. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44458264 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 Pacific hurricane season]]
**[[2018 Pacific hurricane season#Hurricane Bud|Hurricane Bud]] grows into a category four hurricane with winds of {{convert|130|mph}} off of the [[Pacific Coast of Mexico]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hurricane-bud-cabo-today-2018-06-12-live-updates/ (CBS News)]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**[[Hawaiian Airlines]] warns that the eruption of [[Kīlauea]] may hurt bookings and trim revenues. [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/06/11/kilauea-eruption-hurt-bookings-hawaiian-airlines-warns.html (CNBC)]
*A collision between a [[river cruise]] ship and a [[barge]] on [[Russia]]'s [[Volga River]] kills at least 11 people. [http://www.dw.com/en/boat-collision-on-russias-volga-river-kills-11/a-44171686 (Deutsche Welle)]

;Health and environment
*[[Germany]] issues a recall of 73,000 eggs from the [[Netherlands]] suspected to be contaminated with [[fipronil]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44452399 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[2017–18 North Korea crisis]]
**[[2018 North Korea–United States summit]], [[North Korea–United States relations]]
***[[U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] and [[North Korea]]n [[Chairman of the State Affairs Commission|Chairman]] [[Kim Jong-un]] meet for a historic summit on [[Sentosa|Sentosa Island]] in [[Singapore]]. This marks the first time that the leaders of both countries have met. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-44435035 (BBC)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2018/jun/12/trump-kim-summit-meeting-singapore-us-president-north-korea-kim-jong-un- (''The Guardian'')]
***Both sign a joint statement that North Korea will work towards "complete [[Nuclear disarmament|denuclearisation]] of the [[Korean Peninsula]]", and the U.S. will provide "security [[Guarantee (international law)|guarantees]]". The two sides agree to recovering and repatriating the remains of prisoners of war and those missing in action. [https://www.cbsnews.com/live-news/trump-kim-conclude-historic-summit-in-singapore-live-updates-today-2018-06-12-live-updates/ (CBS News)] [https://www.wsj.com/articles/u-s-analysts-skeptical-of-north-korea-summit-results-lack-of-details-1528808231 (''The Wall Street Journal'')] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/news/politics/wp/2018/06/12/trump-and-kim-joint-statement-from-the-singapore-summit/ (''The Washington Post'')]
***After the summit, President Trump says that the U.S. will halt [[United States Forces Korea#Exercises|joint military exercises]] with [[South Korea]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/06/12/politics/trump-north-korea-military-exercises/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-44462628 (BBC)]
*[[Taiwan–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] unveils a new {{convert|6.5|ha|adj=on}} complex in [[Taipei]] for the [[American Institute in Taiwan]], the ''de facto'' U.S. embassy. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-taiwan-diplomacy/u-s-unveils-de-facto-embassy-in-taiwan-amid-china-tensions-idUSKBN1J72QS (Reuters)]
*[[Macedonia naming dispute]], [[Greece–Republic of Macedonia relations]]
**[[Greece]] and the [[Republic of Macedonia]] reach a deal to end a 27-year naming dispute between both countries, which would result in Macedonia being officially renamed the Republic of North Macedonia. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-44401643 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Seattle]]'s [[Seattle City Council|city council]] votes 7–2 to repeal a controversial employer [[Seattle head tax|head tax]], which was approved a month earlier. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2018/jun/12/seattle-amazon-head-tax-repealed-one-month (''The Guardian'')]
